ops.statement: A handoff that mandates BOTH 'rename field X' and 'leave the consumer untouched' for a field the consumer reads is self-contradictory and BLOCKs into rework. Resolve up front: 'untouched' must mean no FORMULA/behaviour change; behaviour-preserving renames of consumer-read fields are allowed and are proven safe by a green suite. Say which you mean, or scope renames to producer/store-only fields.
